interface.name: zsingularity_projection_manager_v1

description.summary: compositor outputs projected to another screen

interface.description: This privileged interface creates outputs that are not attached to a local display. Their content is captured by a client and shown on another screen, such as a car head unit. Each output lives as long as the object that created it.

request.name: create_output
request.description: Creates an output with the given connector name and mode. The name must be unique among projection outputs. The refresh rate is in mHz. The form factor is advertised to clients in the output description as "sinty-projection:" followed by the form factor.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Outputs created through this binding stay until their own objects are destroyed.

request.name: map_touch

description.summary: route a touch device to this output

request.description: Every touch device whose name matches, present now or added later, reports its contacts on this output.

event.name: ready
event.description: Sent once the output is enabled and advertised as wl_output with the given name.

description.summary: the output could not be created
